textHook: Your brain at 3 a.m. be like 🧠
cta: Follow if your brain does this too 🧠

beats.text: It's 3 a.m. and my brain just called an emergency meeting.
beats.speaker: narrator

beats.text: Hey. Remember that thing you said in 2014?
beats.speaker: brain

beats.text: No. Please. I have work in four hours.
beats.speaker: me

beats.text: Cool. Let's replay it forty times. In HD.
beats.speaker: brain

beats.text: That's rumination. Your brain thinks rehearsing it keeps you safe.
beats.speaker: narrator

beats.text: Fix: write the thought down. Brain sees it's handled.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.fxText: Write it down|Close the loop|Go back to sleep

beats.text: Wow. Okay. I'll just… think about sharks then.
beats.speaker: brain

beats.text: Rate your brain's 3 a.m. behaviour. Comment below.
beats.speaker: narrator
